title: 雅思 7 分+ · 随堂测试 4 套

items.title: 雅思 7 分+ · 综合小测 A

questions.stem: 单词 “anomaly” (n.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
anomaly /əˈnɒməli/ n. 异常现象
例：The reading was dismissed as an anomaly.
该读数被视为异常而未采纳。

questions.stem: 单词 “circumvent” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
circumvent /ˌsɜːkəmˈvent/ v. 规避
例：Some firms circumvent the regulation.
一些公司规避这项规定。

questions.stem: 单词 “corroborate” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
corroborate /kəˈrɒbəreɪt/ v. 证实
例：Two witnesses corroborated the account.
两名证人证实了这一说法。

questions.stem: 单词 “disillusioned” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
disillusioned /ˌdɪsɪˈluːʒnd/ adj. 幻想破灭的
例：Many graduates felt disillusioned.
许多毕业生感到理想破灭。

questions.stem: 单词 “endemic” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
endemic /enˈdemɪk/ adj. 地方性的；特有的
例：Corruption was endemic in that sector.
腐败在那个行业普遍存在。

questions.stem: 单词 “evocative” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
evocative /ɪˈvɒkətɪv/ adj. 唤起回忆的
例：The photograph is deeply evocative.
这张照片极能唤起回忆。

questions.stem: On the far side of the valley ______ a small research station.
questions.explanation: 地点状语前置引发全部倒装，谓语直接跟在状语后。

questions.stem: Rarely ______ such a decisive shift in public attitude.
questions.explanation: Rarely 前置触发部分倒装。

questions.stem: 判断：全部倒装只发生在主语为代词的句子中。
questions.explanation: 恰恰相反，主语为代词时通常不倒装（Here it comes.）。

questions.stem: 把 “The design matters most.” 改为 Wh-cleft，最佳的一项是：
questions.explanation: Wh-cleft 结构为 What + 从句 + is + 被强调成分。

options.text: What matters most is the design.
It is matters most the design.
What is the design matters most.

questions.stem: （选自《The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism》）What does the writer say about the two familiar postures?
questions.explanation: 第一段末句明确指出两种推论都站得住，但都不能定论。

options.text: Both inferences are defensible but neither resolves the question
The pessimists rely on no evidence at all

questions.stem: （选自《The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism》）The writer proposes distinguishing risks by whether they are reversible.
questions.explanation: 第二段提出可逆与不可逆的区分。

questions.stem: （选自《The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism》）In which kind of domain does the framing support greater restraint?
questions.explanation: 第三段指出强耦合、错误快速传播的领域需要更多克制。

options.text: Domains where failures are contained and informative
Domains where systems are tightly coupled and errors spread unnoticed
Domains with the largest commercial value

questions.stem: （选自《The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism》）The writer acknowledges that the reversibility criterion could be misused.
questions.explanation: 第四段承认存在把不喜欢的技术归为不可逆以支持禁令的诱惑。

items.title: 雅思 7 分+ · 综合小测 B

questions.stem: 单词 “ephemeral” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
ephemeral /ɪˈfemərəl/ adj. 短暂的
例：Online fame is often ephemeral.
网络名气往往转瞬即逝。

questions.stem: 单词 “fastidious” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
fastidious /fæˈstɪdiəs/ adj. 挑剔的
例：He is fastidious about references.
他对参考文献很挑剔。

questions.stem: 单词 “impartial” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
impartial /ɪmˈpɑːʃl/ adj. 公正的
例：Judges must remain impartial.
法官必须保持公正。

questions.stem: 单词 “insurmountable” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
insurmountable /ˌɪnsəˈmaʊntəbl/ adj. 不可逾越的
例：The barrier is not insurmountable.
这道障碍并非不可逾越。

questions.stem: 单词 “longitudinal” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
longitudinal /ˌlɒnɡɪˈtjuːdɪnl/ adj. 纵向的
例：A longitudinal study tracked 500 children.
一项纵向研究追踪了五百名儿童。

questions.stem: 单词 “nuance” (n.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
nuance /ˈnjuːɑːns/ n. 细微差别
例：Translation often loses nuance.
翻译常常丢失细微差别。

questions.stem: 选出标点与引导词都正确的一项：
questions.explanation: 非限制性从句用 which 且前后都要有逗号。

options.text: The scheme, that began in 2018, has expanded.
The scheme, which began in 2018, has expanded.
The scheme which began in 2018, has expanded.

questions.stem: 判断：限制性定语从句删去后，句子的指称范围会发生改变。
questions.explanation: 限制性从句起限定作用，删去会改变句意范围。

questions.stem: 把 “There was a significant reduction in the utilisation of private vehicles.” 改写得更清晰的是：
questions.explanation: 把名词化还原为动词，主语具体，句子更有力。

options.text: A significant reduction of private vehicle utilisation occurred.

questions.stem: 选出平行结构正确的一项：
questions.explanation: 三个不定式动词原形并列，形式一致。

options.text: The plan aims to cut costs, raising quality, and it improves access.
The plan aims to cut costs, raise quality, and improve access.
The plan aims cutting costs, to raise quality and improvement of access.

questions.stem: （选自《Translation and the Illusion of Equivalence》）What assumption does the writer attribute to the everyday model of translation?
questions.explanation: 第一段开头即描述这一日常模型。

options.text: That meaning exists independently of language and transfers intact
That only literary texts can be translated

questions.stem: （选自《Translation and the Illusion of Equivalence》）The writer argues that adding explicit information about social distance is a neutral solution.
questions.explanation: 第二段明确说两种选择都不中立，且补充信息有过度specify的风险。

questions.stem: （选自《Translation and the Illusion of Equivalence》）What criticism is made of fluent translation?
questions.explanation: 第三段指出流畅译文让外语文本看似本地写成，抹去差异。

options.text: It is too slow to produce
It hides the translator and erases foreignness

questions.stem: （选自《Translation and the Illusion of Equivalence》）According to the passage, machine translation has resolved the theoretical problem.
questions.explanation: 最后一段说明它改变了实践格局但未解决理论问题。

items.title: 雅思 7 分+ · 词汇语法专项

questions.stem: 单词 “interdisciplinary” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
interdisciplinary /ˌɪntədɪsəˈplɪnəri/ adj. 跨学科的
例：Climate science is interdisciplinary.
气候科学是跨学科的。

questions.stem: 单词 “malleable” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
malleable /ˈmæliəbl/ adj. 可塑的
例：Young minds are highly malleable.
年轻的头脑极具可塑性。

questions.stem: 单词 “obfuscate” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
obfuscate /ˈɒbfʌskeɪt/ v. 使模糊
例：Jargon can obfuscate simple ideas.
术语会把简单的观点弄模糊。

questions.stem: 单词 “philanthropic” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
philanthropic /ˌfɪlənˈθrɒpɪk/ adj. 慈善的
例：Philanthropic funding supports the archive.
慈善资金支持这个档案馆。

questions.stem: 单词 “quintessential” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
quintessential /ˌkwɪntɪˈsenʃl/ adj. 典型的
例：It is the quintessential market town.
这是典型的集镇。

questions.stem: 单词 “relinquish” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
relinquish /rɪˈlɪŋkwɪʃ/ v. 放弃
例：She relinquished control of the fund.
她放弃了对基金的控制。

questions.stem: 单词 “stringent” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
stringent /ˈstrɪndʒənt/ adj. 严格的
例：Stringent rules govern data use.
严格的规则管理数据使用。

questions.stem: 单词 “apathy” (n.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
apathy /ˈæpəθi/ n. 冷漠
例：Voter apathy worries campaigners.
选民冷漠让活动人士忧心。

questions.stem: 判断：平行结构只影响文体美观，不影响语法正确性。
questions.explanation: 并列成分形式不一致属于语法错误，会直接影响评分。

questions.stem: The population of Tokyo is larger than ______ of Seoul.
questions.explanation: 替代单数不可数概念 the population，用 that。

questions.stem: He promised to revise the draft and he ______ within a day.
questions.explanation: do so 替代前面的完整动词短语。

questions.stem: 判断：替代词 those 用于替代可数复数名词。
questions.explanation: those of + 名词用于复数比较对象。

questions.stem: 选出标点使用正确的一项：
questions.explanation: 冒号引出清单，清单内部用逗号分隔。

options.text: We tested three materials: steel, aluminium and carbon fibre.
We tested three materials, steel; aluminium; carbon fibre.
We tested three materials — steel: aluminium: carbon fibre.

questions.stem: 分号最恰当的用法是：
questions.explanation: 分号连接的两侧都必须能独立成句。

options.text: 连接两个独立且语义相关的句子

questions.stem: （选自《Infrastructure and the Politics of Maintenance》）Why does the writer say maintenance is politically neglected?
questions.explanation: 第一段指出维护不可见、不可归功、不上镜。

options.text: It is invisible and cannot be attributed to a politician
It is prohibited by accounting rules

questions.stem: （选自《Infrastructure and the Politics of Maintenance》）The passage claims that deterioration proceeds at a steady, linear rate.
questions.explanation: 第三段明确说劣化通常是非线性的。

questions.stem: （选自《Infrastructure and the Politics of Maintenance》）What weakness of bundled contracts is mentioned?
questions.explanation: 第四段指出捆绑合同降低灵活性、需求变化时代价高。

options.text: They reduce flexibility and can be costly when requirements change

questions.stem: （选自《Infrastructure and the Politics of Maintenance》）The writer concludes that publishing asset condition guarantees adequate funding.
questions.explanation: 最后一句说可见性不保证资金，但不可见几乎保证没有资金。

items.title: 雅思 7 分+ · 全真模拟

questions.stem: 单词 “conjecture” (n.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
conjecture /kənˈdʒektʃə/ n. 推测
例：That remains pure conjecture.
那仍然纯属推测。

questions.stem: 单词 “denounce” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
denounce /dɪˈnaʊns/ v. 谴责
例：Several groups denounced the decision.
几个团体谴责了这一决定。

questions.stem: 单词 “embellish” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
embellish /ɪmˈbelɪʃ/ v. 润饰，添枝加叶
例：He embellished the story for effect.
他为效果给故事添枝加叶。

questions.stem: 单词 “epitomise” (v.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
epitomise /ɪˈpɪtəmaɪz/ v. 集中体现
例：The design epitomises simplicity.
这个设计集中体现了简约。

questions.stem: 单词 “formidable” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
formidable /ˈfɔːmɪdəbl/ adj. 令人生畏的
例：They face a formidable opponent.
他们面对一个强劲的对手。

questions.stem: 单词 “imperceptible” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
imperceptible /ˌɪmpəˈseptəbl/ adj. 难以察觉的
例：The change was almost imperceptible.
这一变化几乎察觉不到。

questions.stem: 单词 “interdisciplinary” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
interdisciplinary /ˌɪntədɪsəˈplɪnəri/ adj. 跨学科的
例：Climate science is interdisciplinary.
气候科学是跨学科的。

questions.stem: 单词 “malleable” (adj.) 的正确中文释义是？
questions.explanation:
malleable /ˈmæliəbl/ adj. 可塑的
例：Young minds are highly malleable.
年轻的头脑极具可塑性。

questions.stem: 下列哪一句最能突出“时间”这一信息？
questions.explanation: It-cleft 将 in March 置于焦点位置。

options.text: The committee approved the plan in March.
It was in March that the committee approved the plan.
The plan was approved by the committee.

questions.stem: 判断：分裂句的主要作用是增加句子长度。
questions.explanation: 其核心功能是信息聚焦与对比，而非拉长句子。

questions.stem: “Costs fell sharply, which surprised analysts.” 中 which 指代：
questions.explanation: 非限制性 which 可指代整个前置分句。

questions.stem: 一段中最适合放置高度名词化句子的位置通常是：
questions.explanation: 主题句需要概括性，抽象名词恰当；细节句应具体。

questions.stem: 判断：整篇文章保持同一抽象层级有利于连贯性。
questions.explanation: 优秀写作在概括与具体之间有节奏地切换，形成论证层次。

questions.stem: Not only ______ the budget cut, but the timeline was also shortened.
questions.explanation: Not only 置于句首触发部分倒装，且两侧结构对称。

questions.stem: （选自《Expertise, Judgement and the Limits of Rules》）What is the underlying insight behind checklists?
questions.explanation: 第一段明确说明专家在时间压力下会遗漏常规步骤。

options.text: Experts lack knowledge of their field
Experts fail at routine steps under pressure, and a memory aid removes such errors

questions.stem: （选自《Expertise, Judgement and the Limits of Rules》）The passage says checklists are equally effective for ill-structured problems.
questions.explanation: 第二段指出在结构不良的问题中，清单可能以合规取代思考。

questions.stem: （选自《Expertise, Judgement and the Limits of Rules》）What risk does the writer see in punishing every deviation?
questions.explanation: 第三段说明惩罚一切偏离会得到尽责但失去判断力。

options.text: The organisation loses the capacity for judgement

questions.stem: （选自《Expertise, Judgement and the Limits of Rules》）According to the passage, graded protocols work only if recorded reasoning is genuinely reviewed.
questions.explanation: 最后一段给出这一条件，否则员工只会在纸面上合规。

questions.stem: 在一次以「The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism」为主题的班级研讨课上，老师要求同学们先在 8 分钟内通读全文，逐段标注出作者的核心论点、两条支持性证据以及至少一处作者本人的态度用词；随后与同桌交换笔记，互相解释自己为什么这样划分段落层次；最后请结合你在文中读到的信息，而不是结合你自己的生活经验或常识，判断下面这句话是否与原文表达的意思一致：「The Uneasy Case for Technological Optimism 一文的作者认为，读者只要记住结论就足够了，理解论证过程并不重要。」
questions.explanation: 原文强调的是「理解论证过程」，仅记住结论无法迁移到新的语境中，因此该说法与原文相悖。此题同时用于验证超长题干在 375px 宽度下的换行表现。

questions.stem: 写作题「Some commentators claim …」的建议结构中，第 2 步应当是？

options.text: Qualify the position by identifying the conditions that change the outcome
Conclusion: restate the qualified judgement in fresh wording
Argument 2: analyse knowledge transfer and returnee networks
Concede the strongest version of the opposing case before answering it

questions.explanation: 完整建议结构：1. Reframe the claim precisely and state the degree of agreement；2. Concede the strongest version of the opposing case before answering it；3. Argument 1: analyse the financial asymmetry with a causal mechanism；4. Argument 2: analyse knowledge transfer and returnee networks；5. Qualify the position by identifying the conditions that change the outcome；6. Conclusion: restate the qualified judgement in fresh wording

questions.stem: 判断：本题要求的必备连接词中包含 “It would be simplistic to suggest that”。
questions.explanation: 本题必备连接词：It would be simplistic to suggest that / Granted / The crux of the matter is / Consequently / In the final analysis。批改时缺少任一项都会扣「连接词」维度分。

questions.stem: 写作题「Artificial intelligence …」的建议结构中，第 3 步应当是？

options.text: Propose the distinction that does the real work, such as advisory versus determinative use
Explain why an outright ban misdiagnoses the problem
Steelman the case for a ban: opacity, bias and the absence of redress

questions.explanation: 完整建议结构：1. Define the scope of the decisions under discussion and state the position；2. Steelman the case for a ban: opacity, bias and the absence of redress；3. Explain why an outright ban misdiagnoses the problem；4. Propose the distinction that does the real work, such as advisory versus determinative use；5. Address the strongest objection to that distinction；6. Conclusion: restate the calibrated position

questions.stem: 判断：本题要求的必备连接词中包含 “At first sight”。
questions.explanation: 本题必备连接词：At first sight / The stronger objection is that / What follows from this is / Even so / Taken together。批改时缺少任一项都会扣「连接词」维度分。

questions.stem: 写作题「The diagram below shows …」的建议结构中，第 4 步应当是？

options.text: Compare the two routes at the stage where they reconverge
Describe the distillation sequence in order using passive verbs
Give an overview stating the number of stages and the point of divergence
Describe the osmosis sequence and highlight the brine by-product

questions.explanation: 完整建议结构：1. Paraphrase the diagram description and name both processes；2. Give an overview stating the number of stages and the point of divergence；3. Describe the distillation sequence in order using passive verbs；4. Describe the osmosis sequence and highlight the brine by-product；5. Compare the two routes at the stage where they reconverge

questions.stem: 判断：本题要求的必备连接词中包含 “Initially”。
questions.explanation: 本题必备连接词：Initially / Subsequently / At this stage / Whereas / Finally。批改时缺少任一项都会扣「连接词」维度分。
